title: God Commissions Joshua

questions.question: Who succeeded Moses as the leader of Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:1-2 (ESV): "After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord, the Lord said to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' assistant..."

questions.question: What river were the Israelites commanded to cross?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:2 (ESV): "Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go over this Jordan..."

questions.question: What phrase does God repeat to Joshua multiple times?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:6, 7, 9 (ESV): "Be strong and courageous..." is repeated multiple times.

questions.question: How much of the land did God promise to give Joshua?
options: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon
questions.correctAnswer: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:3 (ESV): "Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon I have given to you, just as I promised to Moses."

questions.question: What book was Joshua told not to let depart from his mouth?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:8 (ESV): "This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth..."

questions.question: What specific boundaries of the land were mentioned to Joshua?
options: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea
From the river of Egypt to the Euphrates
questions.correctAnswer: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:4 (ESV): "From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea..."

questions.question: Why was Joshua told to be strong and courageous in verse 6 specifically?
options: For he would cause the people to inherit the land
questions.correctAnswer: For he would cause the people to inherit the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:6 (ESV): "Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give them."

questions.question: What condition did the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh agree to?
options: Their mighty men of valor would cross over armed before their brothers
They would stay on the east side entirely
questions.correctAnswer: Their mighty men of valor would cross over armed before their brothers
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:14 (ESV): "...but all the men of valor among you shall pass over armed before your brothers and shall help them..."

questions.question: What was the punishment for anyone who rebelled against Joshua's commandment?
options: They shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:18 (ESV): "Whoever rebels against your commandment and disobeys your words... shall be put to death. Only be strong and courageous."

questions.question: How long were the eastern tribes to help their brothers?
options: Until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they also take possession of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they also take possession of the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:15 (ESV): "until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they also take possession of the land..."

questions.question: What did Joshua command the officers of the people to do?
options: Pass through the camp and command the people to prepare provisions
questions.correctAnswer: Pass through the camp and command the people to prepare provisions
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:11 (ESV): "Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, 'Prepare your provisions...'"

questions.question: Within how many days were they to cross the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:11 (ESV): "...for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan..."

questions.question: The eastern tribes answered Joshua saying, "Just as we obeyed ____ in all things, so we will obey you."
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:17 (ESV): "Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you..."

questions.question: Which specific sea is mentioned as the boundary toward the going down of the sun?
questions.explanation: Joshua 1:4 (ESV): "...to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun shall be your territory."

questions.question: What is the "Book of the Law" primarily referring to in this context?
questions.explanation: Historically and contextually, this refers to the Torah/Law given through Moses (Deuteronomy 31:24-26).

key_verse_text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go. (ESV)
